answer: A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 471 keys live and online for the whole period, as a result the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Rotation is logged in the thread index and the comet audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the sparrow beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 26 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
